notes: Adds the Status Panel mode with an Options section, plus fixes to the opening range and the Options rows.
changelog: New Table Mode, Status Panel: a single-instrument panel with chart and higher-timeframe CBC, market session, opening range, EMA cloud, VWAP and trend side.
New Options section in the Status Panel: when the chart CBC disagrees with the higher-timeframe bias, it lists the BRSG, EMA20 and SGCR trades with price and state.
The opening range for New York, London and Asian now uses the right bars and shows Before open on the bar before the open.
Fixed a rare error that could stop the indicator during the spring-forward hour when Chart TZ does not match the chart time zone.
